knowledge_cards.claim: DAW clip/timeline offset is not a valid physical distance cue; depth estimators must be invariant to it.
When timing and level shortcuts are removed, early reflections can carry more single-channel distance information than the late tail.
Matching T60, EDC and echo density can still miss spectral and time-frequency reverberation character.
Changing early-reflection shape can alter snare attack, bloom and apparent body while reverb time remains fixed.
Snare-space choice must be evaluated with guitars and bass active, not accepted from solo drums.
FX-send automation selects events entering an effect; FX-return automation changes all active repeats or tail and is not equivalent.
Extreme stereo widening is best treated as a separate ear-candy layer, not a default property of the dry anchor.
In dense high-frequency competition, controlled darkening plus level can separate a lead guitar better than further brightening.

rule_candidates.name: reject_clip_offset_depth_shortcut
rule_candidates.when: training or evaluating depth from DAW-rendered material
rule_candidates.change: randomize leading silence and clip onset; require invariant depth result
rule_candidates.parameter_range_and_origin: no source-derived shift grid; use several offsets within available pre-roll
rule_candidates.undo: disable estimator if output tracks clip offset

rule_candidates.name: separate_early_shape_from_decay
rule_candidates.when: source needs size without losing the initial hit
rule_candidates.change: hold decay and wet loudness constant while testing early-reflection envelopes
rule_candidates.parameter_range_and_origin: shape categories short/front_loaded/delayed_rise from video; no transferable milliseconds
rule_candidates.undo: bloom masks next hit or tail detaches

rule_candidates.name: do_not_accept_reverb_by_t60_alone
rule_candidates.change: require echo-density, spectro-temporal and listening checks
rule_candidates.undo: metric match sounds metallic, coloured or less preferred

rule_candidates.name: audition_snare_space_in_full_band
rule_candidates.change: choose with bass and guitars active
rule_candidates.undo: solo-preferred setting loses definition in mix

rule_candidates.name: vocal_throw_uses_send_automation
rule_candidates.change: automate effect send rather than global return
rule_candidates.parameter_range_and_origin: no fixed send level or feedback
rule_candidates.undo: word entrance clips or repeats mask next phrase

rule_candidates.name: wide_fx_layer_separate_from_center_anchor
rule_candidates.when: section needs peripheral movement or ear candy
rule_candidates.change: widen dedicated wet layer while keeping dry anchor independently controlled
rule_candidates.undo: image pulls, phasey nausea or anchor weakens

rule_candidates.name: parallel_guitar_distortion_by_section
rule_candidates.when: section lacks excitement and compression makes guitars mushy
rule_candidates.change: test separate phase-consistent parallel distortion and automate by section
rule_candidates.undo: fizz or density rises without excitement

rule_candidates.name: darken_lead_before_more_brightness
rule_candidates.when: lead competes with vocal, cymbals and high-gain rhythm guitars
rule_candidates.change: compare controlled high-frequency reduction plus level against brightening
rule_candidates.parameter_range_and_origin: high-shelf 0/-1.5/-3 dB proposed project grid, not source numbers
rule_candidates.undo: lead becomes dull or remains masked
